name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.income.view.WithdrawSuccessActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK shows this result page after a withdrawal request is submitted. The layout shows a withdrawal-success message and fields for payout method, amount, and application status while the platform processes the request.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the withdrawal confirmation screen.
